title: AARYA Voice Lab Feedback Record (VL-D3 §26, extended by VL-D4 §28)
description: Free-text human feedback attached to a technical object (recording, segment, candidate, or processing result) or a voice preview. NOT a training label -- nothing in this project converts a feedback record into model training data. Stored so a future AI Calibration Engine (VL-D15) can read review disagreement and feedback volume as inputs; it never computes a score itself.

target_id.description: The recording/segment/candidate/preview id this feedback is about.

attributes.description: Structured hints, e.g. {"issue": "too_noisy"}. Free-form but never a speaker or identity field.
